import Mathlib.RingTheory.Polynomial.Radical
theorem p2_n001 (p2v0 : Nat) (p2v1 : Nat) (p2v2 : Nat) (p2v3 : Nat) (p2v4 : Nat) (h0 : (p2v2 ∣ p2v0)) (h1 : (p2v1 ∣ p2v2)) (h2 : (p2v0 ∣ p2v3)) (h3 : (p2v4 < p2v3)) : (1 ≤ p2v3) := by
  exact @Nat.one_le_of_lt p2v4 p2v3 h3

theorem p2_n002 (p2v0 : Nat) (p2v1 : Nat) (p2v2 : Nat) (p2v3 : Nat) (p2v4 : Nat) (h0 : (p2v2 ∣ p2v0)) (h1 : (p2v1 ∣ p2v2)) (h2 : (p2v0 ∣ p2v3)) (h3 : (p2v4 < p2v3)) : (p2v1 ≤ p2v1) := by
  exact @Preorder.le_refl Nat _ p2v1

theorem p2_n003 (p2v0 : Nat) (p2v1 : Nat) (p2v2 : Nat) (p2v3 : Nat) (p2v4 : Nat) (h0 : (p2v2 ∣ p2v0)) (h1 : (p2v1 ∣ p2v2)) (h2 : (p2v0 ∣ p2v3)) (h3 : (p2v4 < p2v3)) : (p2v3 ≤ p2v3) := by
  exact @Preorder.le_refl Nat _ p2v3
